assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Database File Lifecycle: Open connection; Prepare SQL statement; Bind values and execute; Read rows and handle errors; Commit or roll back; Close resources

assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Relational Relationships: Entity: books; Entity: authors; Link table: book_authors; Primary keys identify rows; Foreign keys maintain links; UNIQUE constraints prevent duplicate links
assets.caption: Model one-to-many and many-to-many relationships without duplicating facts
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of SQLite Storage Classes: NULL • missing/unknown; INTEGER • whole number; REAL • floating point; TEXT • encoded text; BLOB • bytes; typeof(value) inspects storage
assets.caption: SQLite stores values using five storage classes; affinity influences conversion
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Query Reading Checklist: FROM and JOIN sources; WHERE filters input rows; GROUP BY forms groups; HAVING filters groups; SELECT shapes output; ORDER BY then LIMIT/OFFSET
assets.caption: A repeatable order helps learners separate row filtering, grouping, sorting and paging
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Reliable Transaction Flow: BEGIN transaction; Check preconditions; Apply related updates; Verify expected row counts; COMMIT on success; ROLLBACK on any failure
assets.caption: Related data changes should succeed together or be rolled back
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Choosing an Index: Capture representative query; Inspect EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN; Choose candidate columns; Create index and retest; Check read/write and size cost; Keep only useful indexes
assets.caption: Index design begins with representative queries and measurements
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of JOIN Result Shapes: INNER JOIN keeps matches; LEFT JOIN keeps left rows; CROSS JOIN creates combinations; Self-join relates rows in one table; Check row multiplication; Aggregate at the intended grain
assets.caption: The selected join controls whether unmatched rows remain in the result
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of JSON Query Workflow: Choose relational vs JSON field; Validate input JSON; Store JSON text or JSONB; Use paths to read values; Handle missing or malformed values; Test runtime version and build
assets.caption: Keep relational keys relational and validate JSON feature support
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Foreign-Key Enforcement: Define referenced primary/unique key; Enable PRAGMA foreign_keys; Set on every connection; Choose ON DELETE/UPDATE actions; Test invalid child insertion; Run foreign_key_check
assets.caption: Foreign keys require correct definitions and per-connection enforcement
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of WAL Concurrency Model: Readers see snapshots; Writer appends to WAL; Commit adds a commit marker; Checkpoint moves pages to database; Keep write transactions short; Handle SQLITE_BUSY deliberately
assets.caption: WAL can improve reader/writer overlap but does not create multiple simultaneous writers
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Backup and Recovery Loop: Select a consistent backup method; Create to separate destination; Verify backup file exists; Run integrity_check; Restore in isolated location; Compare critical records and document
assets.caption: A backup is useful only when a restore is tested
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Safe Query Parameterization: Use placeholders in SQL; Bind user values separately; Allow-list dynamic identifiers; Validate business rules; Limit privileges and extensions; Test adversarial and invalid input
assets.caption: Values are bound as data, not concatenated into SQL syntax
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Safe Schema Migration: Read current schema version; Back up important data; Apply one migration in a transaction when possible; Check schema/data invariants; Update version only on success; Test rollback and old-version paths
assets.caption: Versioned, tested migrations protect existing data during schema changes
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of Full-Text Search Lifecycle: Create source document table; Create FTS virtual table; Decide synchronization strategy; Query terms or phrases; Inspect ranking and snippets; Test insert/update/delete synchronization
assets.caption: An FTS index needs defined synchronization with its source records
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for this course; no external artwork used.

assets.alt_text: Sequence diagram of SQLite Production Readiness: Document workload and topology; Set constraints and transactions; Measure query plans; Plan backups and restore drills; Test failures and migrations; Define diagnostics and recovery steps
assets.caption: Readiness is evidence across data integrity, reliability, security and operations
